$comment: TOHFA design tokens. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for colour, type, spacing and radii across Angular admin, farmer mobile and customer mobile. Never hard-code a hex value in an app.

tohfaTeal.usage: Primary brand colour. Farmer app primary, primary buttons, active nav, links, brand marks.

deepTeal.usage: Pressed/hover state of primary, dark headers, high-contrast text on cream.

tohfaOrange.usage: Admin app brand, secondary CTA, attention badges, pending-approval highlights.

dangerRed.usage: Destructive actions, validation errors, rejected states, expired certificates.

deepBlue.usage: Customer app brand, informational banners, links in customer surfaces.

brownAccent.usage: Main Warehouse Admin role colour, logistics and transfer surfaces.

successDarkGreen.usage: Success confirmations, approved listings, settled payouts, verified certification.

backgroundCream.usage: Default app background and card surface base across all three clients.

purple.usage: Analytics, reporting and audit surfaces; chart primary series.

subWarehouseOrange.usage: Sub Warehouse Admin role colour, warehouse-scoped chips and filters.

deepMaroon.usage: Super Admin role colour, irreversible/override actions, policy settings.

white.usage: Pure white. Card fills that must sit above the cream background, button labels on a filled brand button, and print/PDF surfaces.

grey100.usage: Hairline borders, dividers and disabled surfaces. Background cream carried 8% toward ink.

grey300.usage: Disabled control fills, skeleton placeholders, inactive icons. Cream carried 25% toward ink.

grey500.usage: Secondary/muted text and placeholder text on cream. Cream carried 50% toward ink.

grey700.usage: Tertiary headings and metadata that must stay legible but recede from onSurface. Cream carried 75% toward ink.

black.usage: Scrims and overlays only. Body text uses onSurface (deepTeal), never pure black.

$neutralNote: Neutrals are DERIVED, not picked: greys are the background cream (#F7F5EE) carried 8/25/50/75% toward the ink (deepTeal #04342C), so they stay in the same warm-green family as the brand. white and black are absolute. Any app needing #FFFFFF uses neutral('white') — never a literal.
$typeScaleNote: Values are in pt. The 9/11/13/15/17/20/24/28 ramp maps 1:1 onto Angular rem (÷16) and React Native dp.
$minTouchTargetNote: 44dp/px minimum on every interactive element. Farmers use these apps outdoors, one-handed, on low-end devices.

fontStack.sans: Inter, 'Noto Sans Tamil', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

$fontStackNote: Noto Sans Tamil must appear in every stack: Tamil is a first-class UI language, not a translation layer.
